NEWS

  2022-02-10

  		Apply for support for charitable cultural projects

  		The fund for charitable cultural projects opens for applications on 
Thursday the 10. of February 2022. The deadline for applications is Thursday the 
10. of March 2022.

  It is possible to apply to the fund for charitable cultural projects. 
The fund supports charitable projects with a cultural purpose within 
four areas:

* Democracy and human rights.

* Cultural preservation.

* Cultural understanding.

* Resistance fighters from 2. World War.

Grants are provided for projects that increase engagement with 
democratic issues in new ways, and for projects that increase knowledge of 
historical features in a local area.

In addition, grants are provided for cross-cultural projects that increase knowledge of interpersonal understanding in new 
ways, and for projects and 
activities where the target group is resistance members from 2World War. 
Activities can for example be excursions or single 
events.

The fund has one annual application round, and 
applications cannot be submitted after the deadline. The deadline for applications is 
Thursday the 10. of March 2022.

Read more about the fund and find the application form [5]

Find other government funding opportunities [6]

Follow the Slots- og Kulturstyrelsen on Facebook [7]

Tilskudsportalen - new practice for those who apply for grants
In the coming months, we are phasing in a new portal solution for our 
applicants. As an applicant, you will in the future need to use NemID or 
employee signature when you apply for our funds via the Grants Portal. Only 
a few selected funds must already be applied for via the portal.

Overall overview, greater flexibility, and direct communication with us
With the Grants Portal, you will get an overview of all your applications and 
grants applied for via the portal, at the same time the application process will become more 
flexible. It will among other things become possible to edit your submitted 
applications right up until the application deadline.

Be ready in good time to ensure that you have access to apply
You must with the portal be aware of whether you need to order an 
employee signature - it can take from a few days to several weeks.

Check this in good time to ensure that you have access to apply for 
relevant funds before the application deadline expires.

The employee signature must belong to the organization you are applying on behalf of.

Read more about the Grants Portal
You can find user guides and relevant information here:
Help for the Grants Portal (slks.dk) [8]
